modules.module_title: Understanding traffic movement & pedestrians inside worksite

pcs.pc_description: Understand the basic traffic movement signs and safety signs.
Identify type of traffic and movement & routes of vehicles inside worksite.
Identify the safe vehicle parking area and pedestrian routes and marking.
Understand smooth movement and regulating the traffic at worksite.

modules.module_title: Facilitating the movement of plants & machineries.

pcs.pc_description: Ensure safe movements of heavy machinery & plants like cranes and forklifts and other on-site activities.
Identify & marking of parking areas and pedestrians with day & night signs.
Understand communication with drivers and passing instructions.
Understand records & logbooks to be maintained for vehicles coming in or going out of the worksite.
Understand safe parking for waiting vehicles & visitors’ vehicles.
Pass safety instruction and PPE kit to the visitors.

Maintain personal health and well-being in the workplace; ensure a clean and safe work environment and safe disposal of wastes.
Provide safety training and education to co-workers to enhance awareness and knowledge.

pcs.pc_description: Regulate inbound traffic & outbound traffic at entrance & exit gates.
Regulate inbound & outbound pedestrian workers at entrance & exit gates.
Maintain record of incoming, outgoing vehicles, and pedestrians.

modules.module_title: Traffic management & parking inside the work site.

pcs.pc_description: Ensure parking area maintenance and proper parking of vehicles.
Keep routes free of obstruction inside the work site.
Ensure movement of vehicles & pedestrians on marked and defined routes.

modules.module_title: Directing road traffic when vehicles enter or exit the site.

pcs.pc_description: Direct & guide inbound traffic as per their work and destination.
Ensure & guide inbound traffic as per security & safety instructions.
Ensure & guide outbound traffic to exit gates.
Ensure compliance & record maintenance for each vehicle & pedestrian coming inside and going outside as per instructions.
